user_questions.question: What should 'the original order' be for the over-refund block? Refund__c has no order link; standard Order has 0 records; Transaction__c (Sale/Refund, Total_Amount__c) has 0 records and no link; the agent's order tools say orders live in the external Pronto Orders API (stubbed). Options: A) capture the external order total on the refund at creation (recommended), B) link to Transaction__c Sale records, C) link to standard Order, D) drop the check.
user_questions.simulated_answer: Drop the 'original order' check if there's no order amount.

user_questions.question: All three refund creators (Issue_Refund, Apply_Remediation, IssueRefundReceiptAction/agent action) currently create every refund as Approved. For auto-approval: A) refunds over the limit start as Pending for manual approval, overriding these callers (recommended), B) only apply auto-approval to refunds created manually. Also confirm the limit: under $25 or $25 and under?
user_questions.simulated_answer: Auto-approve <= $25. Otherwise no preference; use your recommended default.

user_questions.question: How should the receipt be sent? A) email to Refund__c.Contact__c using an email template (recommended), B) another channel (SMS/messaging), C) the existing in-chat receipt card is enough.
user_questions.simulated_answer: Receipt on Completed. No preference on channel; use your recommended default.

skill_friction: Step 5 says to ask only intent questions in one message, but the approval-status-for-over-limit question is both intent (changes behavior of existing agent actions, a listed ask trigger) and arguably implied by the requirement wording; SKILL.md gives no rule for when a requirement's own wording counts as 'the requirement asks for' a shared-caller behavior change.

Rule 3 says after two wrong AskCoworker claims verify every kept fact, but gives no guidance on counting: AskCoworker's claims about platform behavior (save order, undelete) cannot be verified by query, so it is unclear whether they count toward the two-wrong threshold.

The simulated answer 'drop the check if there's no order amount' is conditional; SKILL.md's mapping rule covers answers that do not pick an option but not conditional answers whose condition the agent must evaluate from evidence; I tagged the mapping as an assumption.

spec-format says shared reports/dashboards go in a named folder, not unfiled$public, but is silent on email templates; with 0 email folders, placing a template in unfiled$public vs creating an EmailFolder row was a judgment call.

sobject describe of Transaction__c returned no custom fields because of FLS, which could have led to wrongly rejecting it as an order source; org-verification.md mentions this for FieldDefinition but the custom-object scan step does not prompt checking Tooling CustomField for every candidate object.

AskCoworker echoed facts I sent as 'Verified: prior session' and also invented one ('sfdc_accelerate_dms passes Reason__c [Verified: prior session]'); the table's rule treats echoed facts as established, which makes an invented fact labelled the same way easy to accept.
